help: fetch a manifest's payload from its one-use export_urls into the data-* directory sharing the manifest's star (manifest-<X>.json becomes data-<X>/) - refused if it exists; bare lists the manifests held and requires --manifest

args.name: --manifest
args.help: the manifest to fetch - required to fetch anything: each export_url is one-use, so no default picks one; bare lists the candidates

args.name: --to
args.help: deposit under a directory instead of the store (test escape hatch - a directory, never a machine name)

https://claude.ai/export/... (urllib): WRITES nothing outward, but each export_url is one-use: the fetch consumes it (refused loudly under YOGA_NO_SEND)
